svg.text: RACK Designer Next — Project Flow Diagram
Initialization → User Interaction → State Mutation → Proxy Trap → Event Emission → UI Re-render
FLOW 2: USER ACTION → STATE MUTATION → RE-RENDER (Core Reactive Loop)
+ catalog refresh, floor devices, search filter
addRack / deleteRack / updateRack → renderPhysical(), renderStats(), renderOutliner(), renderRackSelector()
addDeviceToRack / moveDevice / deleteDevice → renderPhysical(), renderStats(), renderOutliner(), renderBottomPanel()
addConnection / deleteConnection → renderStats(), renderOutliner(), renderBottomPanel(), renderPhysical() (port indicators)
Gets template from CATALOG by id
Creates device: { id: uid(), rackId, slotStart, ...template }
renderPhysical() → new faceplate appears in rack slot
From context menu or table button
Selects target device, ports, cable type, color
6. renderAll() → full UI redraw from restored state
Clear canvas → draw rooms → draw racks
Hover node → dims unrelated, highlights connected
Auto-save: 3s debounce via requestAnimationFrame when file handle exists
Topology: swaps ctx/canvas globals, calls drawTopo()
1. exportJSON() → { version: 1, project: store._raw, catalog: CATALOG }
Admin: SHA-256(pin) === stored hash → session created
Single listener, source-based dispatch in renderAll()
CORE PRINCIPLE: Never mutate DOM directly. Always update store.state → Proxy triggers _emit('change') → renderAll() redraws UI.
All state lives in store._raw (Proxy ES6). Auto-saves to localStorage on every mutation. Undo/redo via deepClone snapshots (max 30).
